label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Koivun's Breakout Week
items.text: Jackson Koivun earned praise for beating Si-woo Kim at the Presidents Cup and is predicted to have a Jordan Spieth-like season on the PGA Tour.

items.headline: Dunhill Links Returns
items.text: The Alfred Dunhill Links Championship resumes at St. Andrews with Bob MacIntyre defending his title across Old Course, Carnoustie, and Kingsbarns courses.

items.headline: DeChambeau's LIV Future
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau remains undecided about his future as LIV Golf faces uncertainty, raising questions about his next moves.
